title: SHORT FUSE
subtitle: THURSDAY INTERVALS. OFFICE KIT. NO HIDING.

script.welcome: ON YOUR FEET. THURSDAY. SHORT FUSE INTERVALS. FIFTEEN MINUTES. THAT CHAIR IS NOT YOUR MUM.
script.start: CLOCK IS LIVE. MOVE YOUR ARSE.
script.nextSet: RESET. NEXT ROUND. EMPTY THE TANK A BIT.
script.rest: REST. BREATHE. DO NOT COLLAPSE INTO THE FURNITURE.
script.lastSet: LAST ROUND. FINISH CLEAN. I AM WATCHING.
script.complete: DISMISSED. YOU SHOWED UP. THAT IS THE BARE MINIMUM AND I WILL TAKE IT. SEE YOU TOMORROW.
script.pause: HOLD. CLOCK STOPPED. DO NOT GET COMFY.

exercises.name: STEP-UPS
exercises.cue: DRIVE THROUGH THE WHOLE FOOT. STAND TALL AT THE TOP. SOFT LANDING.
exercises.speakStart: STEP-UPS ON THE STAIRS. TWO SETS. EIGHT EACH LEG. DRIVE UP. STAND TALL. NO WOBBLY SHITE.
exercises.speakRest: THIRTY SECONDS. SHAKE THE LEGS. STAY OFF THE COUCH.

exercises.name: INCLINE PUSH-UPS
exercises.cue: HANDS ON A STAIR OR STURDY EDGE. CHEST TO THE EDGE. LOCK OUT CLEAN.
exercises.speakStart: INCLINE PUSH-UPS. TWO SETS OF EIGHT. HANDS UP ON THE STAIR. CHEST IN. LOCK OUT. KNEES IF YOU MUST, LAZY BONES.
exercises.speakRest: THIRTY. SHAKE THE ARMS. DO NOT LIE DOWN.

exercises.name: REVERSE LUNGE
exercises.cue: LONG STEP BACK. FRONT KNEE TRACKS THE TOE. TOUCH THE CHAIR IF YOU NEED BALANCE.
exercises.speakStart: REVERSE LUNGES. TWO SETS. SIX EACH LEG. CONTROL THE DROP. CHAIR FOR BALANCE IF YOU ARE WOBBLY. OWN IT.

exercises.name: MOUNTAIN CLIMBERS
exercises.cue: HIPS LOW. STEADY DRIVE. THIS IS THE FUSE. DO NOT RUSH FORM.
exercises.speakStart: MOUNTAIN CLIMBERS. TWO ROUNDS. TWENTY FIVE SECONDS. HIPS LOW. STEADY. THIS IS YOUR INTERVAL. MOVE.
exercises.speakRest: THIRTY. BREATHE. NEXT ONE COMES FAST.

exercises.name: DEAD BUG
exercises.cue: LOW BACK FLAT ON THE FLOOR. SLOW OPPOSITE ARM AND LEG. POSTURE DRILL. NO RUSH.
exercises.speakStart: DEAD BUG. TWO SETS. SIX EACH SIDE. BACK FLAT. SLOW. THIS FIXES YOUR DESK HUNCH. DO NOT RUSH IT YOU MADMAN.
exercises.speakRest: TWENTY FIVE. KEEP THE BACK QUIET.

exercises.name: SIDE PLANK
exercises.cue: HIPS HIGH. STACK THE FEET OR DROP THE BOTTOM KNEE. BALANCE THE SIDE. DO NOT SAG.
exercises.speakStart: SIDE PLANK. TWO HOLDS. TWENTY SECONDS EACH SIDE. HIPS UP. BALANCE. DROP THE KNEE IF YOU NEED IT. NO SAGGING.
exercises.speakDone: SIDE PLANKS DONE. THAT IS THE LOT.
